tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אֶשָּׂא לְמֵרָחוֹק
Essa Laméraḥoq by Aharon ben Yosef of Constantinople (13th c.)

tei:div.tei:head: Essa Laméraḥoq by Aharon ben Yosef of Constantinople (13th c.)

tei:lg.tei:l: I will speak my mind regarding [matters] long ago,
I will declare the righteous deeds of my God and my rescuer:
In six days He finished everything – my King and my shepherd,

tei:l.tei:hi: And God blessed the seventh day.

tei:lg.tei:l: He wondrously wrought everything, and His splendor covered heaven.
May the high and lofty One be elevated and uplifted,
He who sanctified this day from everything that had been made,

tei:l.tei:hi: From all His labor that He had done.

tei:lg.tei:l: The beginning of His worth is truth, in a concealed secret.
[To] the nation He chose as an estate, from long ago,
He commanded to prepare themselves a double portion of bread –

tei:l.tei:hi: To do the Sabbath, for [all] their generations, an eternal covenant.

tei:lg.tei:l: He bequeathed an inheritance to the children of Jacob, as a testimony, for their glory:
The day of enjoyment, the day of holiness, the honored day, for their honor.
Indeed, they tell of His righteous deeds when they assemble together,

tei:l.tei:hi: They thank Adonai for His kindness, and for His wondrous deeds for people.
